::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru firm designing ultra-low-power edge-AI SoCs. Raised ₹25 crore in January 2026 to fund two test-chip tape-outs during 2026, with a production chip targeted for 2027. Partner in the 3rdiTech–Kaynes–SPARSHIQ vision-systems consortium (Sept 2025).
:::

## What does this firm design?

SenseSoC ultra-low-power SoCs combining AI inference, wireless connectivity and analog front-ends for IoT, wearables and medical devices.
